notes.summary: ChatLocale gained nine required queue keys. A hand-written full ChatLocale object no longer compiles until it has them. Partial<ChatLocale> overrides are unaffected.
notes.howTo: Add these keys to every full ChatLocale object: queueTitle, queueSendNowLabel, queueEditLabel, queueRemoveLabel, queuePausedLabel, queueResumeLabel, queueSaveLabel, queueCancelLabel, queueFilesLabel. The locale and locales props of AiChatProvider take Partial<ChatLocale>, so partial tables and overrides need no change.

notes.summary: Opt-in message queue: with queue: { enabled: true } a message sent while a run is busy or an approval is open is queued and sent once the chat is idle, instead of being refused.
notes.howTo: Set queue: { enabled: true } on AiChatProvider (config.queue on <glirastes-chat>). Read and steer it with useChatQueue() or the context's submit, sendNow, editQueued and removeQueued; hide the default list with components.ChatQueue: null. Without queue nothing changes. See docs/chat-queue.md.

notes.summary: onModelInput and prepareModelMessages onBreakdown report unresolvedMentionMarkers: how many mention markers in earlier assistant text no declared record or user mention carries. A count only.
notes.howTo: Read breakdown.unresolvedMentionMarkers in an onModelInput hook to spot answers whose mention markers the chat shows as plain text under entityLinks.verifyMentions. Computed only when the hook is set; nothing leaves the server.

notes.summary: Generated labels per language no longer repeat a region variant whose labels equal its base language (de-DE next to de). Generated outputs change once; glirastes tools check reports drift until you refresh.
notes.howTo: Run `glirastes tools refresh` as a developer, review the diff (the duplicate variant leaves tool-contracts.json labels, toolTexts and the runtime artifact) and commit it. Lookups fall back from de-DE to de, so the chat shows the same labels.
